Entdecke tolle Angebote in unserem Sale und sichere dir hochwertige Highlights fuer dein Zuhause zu unschlagbaren Preisen.') and /collections/aktion-rabattfahige-artikel ('Season of Home Sale', 1222 products - roughly two-thirds of the site's ~1867-item full catalog, i.e. a broad 'discount-eligible items' tag rather than a curated markdown list). This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's own characterization of this site's promotions ('End of Summer Sale' banner, no liquidation/closing-down language). Per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule this is excluded outright (not flagged ambiguous - the evidence here is clear, not uncertain). Conclusion: no genuine Clearance PLP exists on this site at the time of checking.
